result.summary: The page is generally well-structured and functional. The most significant visual issue is that the top-right circular icon (likely a user profile or notification bell) is missing its icon, showing only a red dot, which could confuse users. There are also minor layout issues with the horizontally scrolling categories and restaurant lists being cut off at the edge of the screen.

issues.description: The circular button in the top right corner appears empty except for a red notification dot. The intended icon (e.g., profile, bell, or menu) is missing.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the icon inside the circular button is properly loaded and displayed.

issues.description: The horizontally scrolling category filters (All, Pizza, Sushi, etc.) and restaurant cards are abruptly cut off at the right edge of the screen without a clear visual cue that more content exists to the right.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a subtle fade or shadow on the right edge to indicate scrollability, or ensure the last visible item has enough margin.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated in the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: While truncation is common in horizontal lists, ensure the full name is accessible via tooltip or upon clicking the card.
